programme.title: Focke-Wulf 190
programme.desc: "Als die Focke Wulf 190 im Juni 1939 ihren Jungfernflug machte, war es ohne Zweifel das modernste Kampfflugzeug der Welt. Schweres Feuergeschütz und ein enormes Leistungsniveau gaben der kleinen Sternmotor-Maschine die Möglichkeit, jeden vergleichbaren alliierten Flieger zu deklassieren. Als die Focke Wulf 1941 zum Einsatz kam, war sie sofort erfolgreich: Sie fügte dem Gegner so schwere Verluste zu, dass sie blad unter dem Namen "Butcher Bird" bekannt wurde. Während der verbleibenden vier Kriegsjahre wurde die Focke Wulf 190 an allen Kriegsschauplätzen von den Deutschen eingesetzt: Von Nordafrika bis Russland."

programme.title: Die Geheimen Flugobjekte des Dritten Reiches - Teil 1
programme.desc: Trotz der sich abzeichnenden Niederlage entwickelte die deutsche Seite in der letzten Kriegsphase noch zahlreiche Jagdflugzeuge, Bomber und Raketen mit bahnbrechenden technischen Eigenschaften. Geheimnisumwitterte Waffen, mit denen Hitler das Kriegsglück wenden will. Doch alle Anstrengungen sind vergeblich. Nach der Kapitulation beginnt der Wettlauf der Sieger um die Patente und die Spitzenkräfte der deutschen Waffenindustrie. Militärische Sondereinheiten und Geheimdienste beschlagnahmen Hunderttausende Konstruktionszeichnungen, Unterlagen und Modelle, die unter strengster Geheimhaltung in die USA und die UdSSR transportiert werden. Diese Dokumentation eröffnet einen Blick hinter die Kulissen und zeigt, welche bahnbrechenden technischen Konstruktionen am Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs auf deutscher Seite entwickelt, gebaut und erprobt wurden. Aufbauend auf Unterlagen, die bislang nicht zugänglich waren, erwecken aufwendige Animationen die „Geheimen Flugprojekte des Dritten Reiches“ zum ersten Mal zum Leben.

programme.title: Die Geheimen Flugobjekte des Dritten Reiches - Teil 2
programme.desc: Kurz vor dem Zusammenbruch 1945 entwickelt das NS-Regime futuristische Düsenjäger und Raketen als letzte Hoffnung. Nach der Kapitulation beginnt der geheime Wettlauf der Siegermächte: Wer sichert sich die deutschen Konstruktionspläne und die klügsten Köpfe? Diese Doku zeigt die Jagd auf die geheimsten Flugprojekte – rekonstruiert mit seltenen Originalaufnahmen und packenden 3D-Animationen!

programme.title: Mean Dreams
programme.desc: Irgendwo in den endlosen Weiten des Mittleren Westens: Jonas ist fünfzehn und hat genug vom harten Leben auf der Farm seiner Eltern. Als die hübsche Casey mit ihrem Vater Wayne ein Haus in der Nähe bezieht, verknallt sich der Farmersjunge bis über beide Ohren in das Mädchen, und von nun an sind die beiden unzertrennlich. Das führt bald zu einem ernsthaften Konflikt mit ihrem Vater, der als verbitterter Polizist seine Tochter mit strenger Hand regiert. Dann stolpert Jonas auch noch durch Zufall in Waynes geschickt eingefädelten Drogendeal, der unverhofft aus dem Ruder läuft. Unter Lebensgefahr verschwindet der Junge in der finsteren Nacht – mit einer Tasche voller Geld und der entgeisterten Casey im Schlepptau. Verfolgt vom korrupten Gesetzeshüter und der gesamten Polizei flüchten Jonas und Casey durch ein atemberaubend schönes, aber unbarmherziges Land, das ihre Liebe zueinander auf den Prüfstand stellt und ihr zukünftiges Leben bedroht. Um endlich frei zu sein, bleibt ihnen keine andere Wahl, als sich dort draußen ihrem schlimmsten Feind in einem fast aussichtlosen Kampf zu stellen …

programme.title: Borders of Love
programme.desc: Hana und Petr befinden sich in einer Ehekrise und beschließen, ihre Beziehung für andere sexuelle Partner zu öffnen. Unter der Bedingung, dass sie ihre Erfahrungen ehrlich miteinander teilen, lassen sie sich auf das Experiment ein.

programme.title: Forget and Forgive
programme.desc: Die Polizistin Anna Walker entkommt nach einem Angriff nur knapp dem Tod. Als sie im Krankenhaus aufwacht, leidet sie an Amnesie - all ihre Erinnerungen sind ausgelöscht. Bei dem Versuch, ihr bisheriges Leben zu rekonstruieren, muss sie erkennen, dass sie aus beruflichem Ehrgeiz ihren Mann und ihre Tochter jahrelang vernachlässigt hat. Doch Annas Fortschritte führen sie und ihre Familie bald in große Gefahr.

programme.title: Charmant, ledig, sucht...
programme.desc: Die gebildete Grace Gordon kehrt 1963 nach dem Tod ihres Vaters in den tiefsten Süden der USA zurück und stellt fest, dass es für Frauen dort kaum Chancen auf ein selbstbestimmtes Leben gibt. Ihre Suche nach einem geeigneten Heiratskandidaten verläuft enttäuschend. Also beschließt sie zusammen mit ihren zwei farbigen Dienstmädchen und dem lokalen Kongressabgeordneten Worth eine Kampagne zu starten. Gemeinsam kämpfen sie für die Gleichberechtigung der Frau und gegen den Rassismus.

programme.title: Eine Million Küsse - Wie angel' ich mir einen Millionär?
programme.desc: Die alleinerziehende Alicia (Malgorzata Socha) hält sich und ihren Sohn Kuba (Iwo Rajski) seit der Scheidung mehr schlecht als recht mit allerlei Aushilfsjobs über Wasser. Da trifft es sich gut, dass sie durch Zufall in einen hochdotierten Millionärs-Workshop stolpert, dessen Teilnehmer von der knallharten Businessfrau Sonia Babicz (Malgorzata Foremniak) in erfolgreichen Jagdmethoden auf lukrative Heiratskandidaten geschult werden. Anfangs widerstrebend, zieht es Alicia nach und nach immer tiefer in die glamouröse Welt der Reichen und Schönen. Doch um hier den Richtigen zu finden, muss sie schließlich eine schwere Entscheidung treffen. Die junge Mutter erwarten einige durch und durch turbulente Tage auf der Suche nach der wahren Liebe...

programme.title: Maurice
programme.desc: Hugh Grant in seiner ersten Hauptrolle. An der Universität von Cambridge verlieben sich die Studenten Maurice und Clive im Jahre 1909 wider die gesellschaftlichen Normen ineinander. Literatur-Spezialist James Ivory, adaptierte mit diesem Meisterwerk einen Roman von E. M. Forster und erhielt dafür den Silbernen Löwen bei den Filmfestspielen von Venedig.

programme.title: Rosemari
programme.desc: Eine Braut entdeckt in einer Hoteltoilette ein Baby. 16 Jahre später taucht das Mädchen vor ihrer Haustür auf und hofft, mit ihrer Hilfe ihre biologischen Eltern zu finden. Eine lustige, berührende Geschichte darüber, wie aus Sex, Lügen und Biologie eine schöne Blume - Rosemari - entstehen konnte.

programme.title: Von Frau zu Frau
programme.desc: Eine sich einmischende Mutter versucht, ihre Tochter mit dem richtigen Mann zu verkuppeln, damit ihr Kind nicht in ihre Fußstapfen tritt.

programme.title: The Dinner
programme.desc: Ein Blick darauf, wie weit Eltern gehen würden, um ihre Kinder zu schützen. Spielfilm nach einem Roman von Herman Koch.

programme.title: The Women - Von großen und kleinen Affären
programme.desc: Was würden Sie tun, um sich an Ihrem Ehemann zu rächen?Sylvie Fowler (ANNETTE BENING) ist die etwas aufgedrehte und ständig gestresste Herausgeberin eines New Yorker Fashion-Magazins. Eines Tages trifft sie fast der Schlag, als ihr bei der Maniküre eine geschwätzige Kosmetikerin verrät, dass die Parfümverkäuferin und Nachwuchs-Aktrice Crystal Allen (EVA MENDES) eine Affäre mit dem erfolgreichen Börsenmakler Stephen Haines hat. Dieser ist ausgerechnet der Ehemann von Sylvies bester Freundin, der perfektionistischen Society-Lady Mary Haines (MEG RYAN). Bald weiß von diesem Skandal ganz New York und die Gerüchteküche brodelt. Als Mary schließlich selbst erfährt, dass ihr scheinbar perfekter Ehemann eine Affäre hat, bricht für sie eine Welt zusammen. Aber dank der vielleicht nicht immer ganz angebrachten Hilfe ihrer Freundinnen holt Mary schon bald zum Gegenschlag aus…

programme.title: Quartett D'Amour – Liebe, wen du willst
programme.desc: Rachel, die in einem Schmuckatelier arbeitet, lernt Vincent kennen, einen charmanten Webdesigner. Fasziniert von seiner Offenheit lädt sie ihn und seine Partnerin Teri zum Abendessen mit ihrem Mann Franck ein. Was als harmloses Treffen beginnt, entwickelt sich schnell zu einer leidenschaftlichen Affäre zwischen allen Beteiligten. Die vier lassen sich auf eine Beziehung ohne Regeln und ohne Lügen ein – ein emotionales Experiment zwischen Liebe, Lust und Freiheit. Heimlich leben sie ihre neue Konstellation aus, fernab von ihren Kindern und dem sozialen Umfeld. Doch je intensiver die Gefühle werden, desto mehr geraten sie in ein Geflecht aus Eifersucht, Unsicherheit und innerer Zerrissenheit. Die Grenzen zwischen Freundschaft, Liebe und Besitz verschwimmen.

programme.title: Geheimes Verlangen
programme.desc: Dr. Veronica Simon (Mira Sorvino) ist eine herausragende Psychologin, die ihre Karriere den politischen Ambitionen ihres Mannes Jake (Cary Elwes) unterordnet. Dann lernt sie in einer Galerie den jungen verführerischen Künstler Victor Bernard (Christopher Backus) kennen und verfällt dessen unbekümmertem Charme. Sie beginnt eine heiße Affäre mit ihm, die ein hemmungsloses Wochenende zur Folge hat. Victor beginnt daraufhin, sich mehr und mehr in das Leben von Jake und Veronica einzuschleichen und spätestens, als er sich an Tochter Lizzy (Katherine McNamara) heranmacht, muss Veronica erkennen, dass ihr erotisches Abenteuer einen dunklen Schatten obsessiver Leidenschaft über ihre Familie wirft. Sie muss sich von Victor trennen, bevor er ihre Familie endgültig zerstört...

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Right Up Your Alley
programme.desc: As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- & Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

programme.title: Metal Detector
programme.desc: Look no further! This is the right place for everything heavy. Your quest has ended so, lean back, turn up that sound system to a solid 11 and enjoy the ride. You have been warned…

programme.title: Wishbone Ash - Live in London - 40th Anniversary Concert
Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The entire political and law enforcement, hierarchy of a rural town is involved in an extortion-murder scheme which preys on wealthy, young women as "Angels in Chains" airs on the new series, "Charlie's Angels." The half-sister of a missing girl prompts a Charlie's Angels investigation of a country prison farm and a nearby small town sheriff. Kelly and Jill deliberately get arrested for speeding. They are sentenced by a "kangaroo court" to unusually long terms at the nearby prison-farm. Once there, they discover that the sheriff, prison authorities, and the local County Manager are partners in an extortion-murder scheme. Wealthy young women without relatives are arrested and jailed on trumped-up violations. The women are virtually enslaved until they sign over all their assets in exchange for an "early release" and then killed. Those inquiring further are told that the missing girls have been paroled. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: A sexploitation empire is threatened when its nude centerfold models are mysteriously murdered in "Lady Killer," on "Charlie's Angels."

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Two Army officers profiting from drug purchases murder in order to protect their scheme as "Bullseye" airs on "Charlie's Angels." A recruit in the Women's Army Corps is shot to death on the firing range and Charlie's Angels are assigned to investigate. Bosley works undercover as a civilian researcher with Sabrina as an Array nurse and Jill and Kelly as new enlistees. A military physician and a cruel drill instructor are discovered to be purchasing large quantities of cheap, inactive drugs and reselling them to the Army at top quality retail prices. Unfortunately, before the Angels can complete their investigation, they become the targets of a "search--and-destroy" mission. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: A computer dating service, fronting for prostitutes and their robber accomplices, starts an underworld war by stealing hot diamonds from a syndicate courier in "The Consenting Adults" on "Charlie's Angels." A prostitute supplied by a computer dating service keeps an antique dealer preoccupied while his store is burglarized of priceless art objects. One of the stolen items is a ceramic frog, stuffed with smuggled diamonds -- belonging to a ruthless crime syndicate boss. Thinking he is lying about the thefts, the enraged kingpin kidnaps the antique dealers and Charlie's Angels enter the case. Jill infiltrates the dating service posing as a hooker but finds that the prostitute involved in the burglary has led the crime boss to the diamonds. In a last ditch effort to gain evidence, Angels Sabrina and Jill disguise themselves as veterinarians and steal the syndicate chieftain's championship racehorse. The chieftain agrees to meet the Angels in a park and turn over the diamonds in exchange for his horse. In the exciting climax, Angel Jill must make a getaway with the evidence on her skateboard -- chased by a syndicate hit man Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kelly is a dead-ringer for a famous (murdered) photographer's model Night of the Strangler" on "Charlie's Angels." A series of rag doll stranglings brings Charlie's Angels (Kelly, Jill and Sabrina) into the case. Charlie counts on Kelly's resemblance to the first murdered girl to attract the killer. The wife of a well-known fashion designer is the next victim. Narrowing the possibilities, Charlie's Angels date the three most suspect men -- knowing full well one of them is a killer of great ingenuity and imagination. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Across the lake Vierwaldstättersee with the “Unterwalden”
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: Wildlife filmmakers often risk life and limb trying to capture unique images of their dangerous protagonists. In the Kruger National Park Josef Jozefowicz steps into a lionesses' den to film her cubs, in Alaska Andreas Kieling mingles with giant elk bulls in order to film them in action, and in Florida his colleague Zoltan Török gets very close to an alligator mother guarding its nest. The life of the film-makers is also threatened by elemental forces, and failing technical equipment: the strong and tearing current of the Yukon River throws Andreas Kieling's boat onto a gravel bank, in the Democratic Republik of Congo camerawoman Heike Grebe is separated from her colleagues in the dense rainforest, in Kamchatka a film team only just escapes a gigantic landslide, and in Finland a hot-air balloon catches fire and becomes the nightmare of Oliver Goetzl and Ivo Nörenberg. The last episode "Wild Moments - Dangerous and Deadly" follows wildlife film-makers on their adventurous journeys throughout the world.

programme.title: mareTV: Denmarks Limfjord - From Sea to Sea
programme.desc: Wide open spaces, water, meadows: The Limfjord stretches through Jutland in Denmark in countless bays, canals and sounds. Mighty water castles, country palaces and magnificent monasteries are enthroned on its shores. It is a rather lonely area, even in high summer it is quiet. This is probably why the people here are so friendly and sociable. Birte, Silla and Bo cycle to their fjord garden project in the harbor of the town of Løgstør to harvest mussels, oysters and seaweed. They think gardening is best in a club. Luckily, Silla, a resourceful tinkerer, has just made another ingenious invention: the mussel washing machine. Cruising the narrow Næssund, a branch of the Limfjord, is the Næssund Ferry, the smallest and oldest car ferry in the area. New on board, and the first and only woman on this ship, is deckhand Lilian Kohler. She is "girl for everything", but wants more, because Lilian is a trained navigator. She is magically drawn to the bridge, but the old captain doesn't think much of retiring ashore.

Mighty water castles, country palaces and magnificent monasteries are enthroned on its shores. It is a rather lonely area, even in high summer it is quiet. This is probably why the people here are so friendly and sociable. Birte, Silla and Bo cycle to their fjord garden project in the harbor of the town of Løgstør to harvest mussels, oysters and seaweed. They think gardening is best in a club. Luckily, Silla, a resourceful tinkerer, has just made another ingenious invention: the mussel washing machine. Cruising the narrow Næssund, a branch of the Limfjord, is the Næssund Ferry, the smallest and oldest car ferry in the area. New on board, and the first and only woman on this ship, is deckhand Lilian Kohler. She is "girl for everything", but wants more, because Lilian is a trained navigator. She is magically drawn to the bridge, but the old captain doesn't think much of retiring ashore.

programme.title: mareTV: The white wilderness in Greenland's East
programme.desc: Fjords, glaciers and the highest mountains in the Arctic: East Greenland with its spectacular nature is one of the most sparsely populated regions on earth. The people here live in extreme isolation and depend on helicopter flights for their supplies. Despite harsh conditions, the inhabitants here lovingly maintain their traditions and enjoy their outdoor leisure time even at minus 20 degrees Celsius. The town of Tasiilaq is the "metropolis" with 4,000 inhabitants and offers a very special attraction: the only ski lift on the east coast. Thomas Mikaelsen, the lift attendant, is not to be envied for his job. The only 100 meter long lift comes from Switzerland and is already 20 years old. If Thomas gets the drag lift running at all, it often only lasts for an hour. Then the ski crazy's luck depends on his repair skills. The lift is the only frosty open-air pleasure. For Salo Kunuk his sled dogs are both pleasure and work. He is currently teaching his daughter Karla how to steer a dog sled, private driving lessons from her father, so to speak. Karla will need it, because in the eternal ice the sled is the only means of transportation.

programme.title: The Last Paradises: Patagonia - Coast of the Killer Whale
programme.desc: On the wild coast of Patagonia, the nature calendar describes the most diverse visiting times of fascinating animals, from the southern right whale and other large whales, via the sea lions and elephant seals up to the orcas and millions of penguins. The encounters with whales and their babies are spectacular. Hardly anywhere else on earth can one experience both the brutal and the delightful sides of nature so vividly and so close. The trip to the hot spots for animal watchers and researchers leads us inter alia to the Caleta Valdez. This is where, during the mating season, the southern elephant seals bring their babies into the world, mate and enjoy a little sunbathing on the beach.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.sub-title: Over the Islands of Africa, Zanzibar
programme.desc: Photographer Matthias Ziegler is an Africa specialist. He has visited nearly every country on the continent on assignments for international agencies. Zanzibar, however, is new territory for him. He's come to the former slave island for a photo book – and this time he's not alone. To see the Tanzanian archipelago from the air, he has enlisted the services of ultralight pilot Richard Meredith-Hardy of England to fly him around in his FIB, or flying inflatable boat. Perfect conditions for an adventurous journey: as a world champion ultralight pilot, Richard and his FIB can take off and land practically anywhere – in theory.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.sub-title: Over the Islands of Africa, Mauritius
programme.desc: Renaud Van Der Meeren is a photographer and paramotor pilot. With his motorised parachute he goes on expeditions to the remotest corners on earth to photograph people and landscapes from the air. Renaud wanted to be a jet pilot, studied music at the Sorbonne, became a ski instructor, model and photographer's assistant before he found happiness in his current vocation. He especially likes to do his job in Mauritius – nowhere else does he find so many motifs as on the "sweetest pearl in the Indian Ocean". This time he's working on a photo book about Mauritius – by land, by water and in the air.

programme.title: In the Heart of Scotland - By Train trough the Lowlands
programme.desc: The first part of this journey through Scotland begins in the colourful and vibrant capital, Edinburgh. It takes us through the rolling hills of the Scottish Lowlands, en route to the wild, picturesque east coast and Aberdeen. There are new and exciting views behind every bend: heath-covered hills with a magically purple glow, beautiful lakes and forests of the deepest shades of green. The breath-taking camerawork for this documentary received the Columbus Film Award.

programme.title: mareTV: Scotland's Mild West - On The Inner Hebrides
programme.desc: The Inner Hebrides surprise with green hills, fine sandy beaches and a mild climate, at least as far as Scottish conditions allow. This is ensured by the currents of the Gulf Stream, as well as the Scottish archipelago being protected by its sister islands, which belong to the Outer Hebrides. More than half of the almost 80 islands are uninhabited. Loneliness has made the people rather inventive. On Tiree Island, mathematics, history and physics from the mainland arrive in the classroom per mouseclick. Dr Mauvis Gore and Prof. Rupert Ormond cast off from the island of Mull, after setting a course to encounter a basking shark. The cetohinus maximus is the world's second largest fish and the two scientists are absolutely convinced that the waters surrounding the Mull constitute the mating grounds for the basking sharks. A logistical challenge takes place on the Isle of Easdale each September. Then, around 400 people populate the tiny slate island. Donals "Mellon" Melville organises the World Skimming Championships, a World Cup in jumping stones. This is all about the distance they are thrown and they must only hop above the water twice.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: As contrasting as the landscapes of the 15th meridian east, so different are its animal inhabitants. What are the living conditions like in the heat of the Namibian Damaraland, in Lusatia or on the coast of Norway? Which challenges do elephants, whales or kingfishers have to master together with their companions from north to south?

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: mareTV: Ibiza - Island of Light
programme.desc: The light of the Balearic island of Ibiza is magical and its trademark: The "Island of Light" is tiny compared to its sister island Mallorca, but offers the most beautiful sunsets in the world. That's what they say. They attract sun worshippers and party people from near and far. To the sounds of the famous "Balearic Sound" they turn night into day. This documentary documents the island in the balancing act between luxury yachts and traditions. Hippie culture, celebrities, pine forests, bays with turquoise water and villages with bright white houses: Ibiza has many faces. Mora (80) and Djin (67) have been drawn to the island for 55 years. They are the uncrowned kings of the hippies. But only love, light, air and laziness, these times are also long gone on Ibiza. Mora knits sexy jerseys for young hippies from morning till night. Djin helps her sell at the famous Las Dalias hippie market and works as a construction worker: chilling and no pension in sight. The virgin Carmen is the patron saint of the sailors. On her day of honour, a mass is celebrated in the port city of Eivissa. Afterwards, fishermen carry the Virgin through the narrow streets of Ibiza City down to the quay. And then Carmen sets sail. Several places on Ibiza claim to offer the most beautiful sunset in the world: In front of Cala de Benirrás, the sun sinks right next to the iconic rock Cap Benat, which the locals awefully call "God's Finger". The typical soft beats over the sea sound from almost all the bays and provide deep relaxation worldwide under the term "Balearic Sound". Some of the famous DJs are jetting around the globe for huge fees. But in the small beach bars, the Chiringuitos, the island sound is celebrated further. On the beach of Cala Salada the Brit Joe Burnley has the command over a troop of mermaids. The ladies squeeze into the tight mermaid costume for the good cause. With great grace they swim towards yachts that are forbidden to anchor on sea grass meadows. Charming but unyielding, they point out the offence to the captain and crew; a creative environmental action to save the endangered Neptune gas, green lung of the sea and habitat for Ibiza's seahorses. The underwater photographer Manu San Felix is also committed to the endangered seahorses. Using a probe, he maps the coastal area around Ibiza and feeds the data into a GPS app. No skipper should be able to say that he didn't even know that his anchor was clawing into Neptune grass. On land, Manu is dedicated to breeding seahorses. His plan: He wants to expose the animals in the Mediterranean to Ibiza and Formentera in order to secure their population. Garages on the beach? programme.title: mareTV: Majorca
programme.desc: "Cleaning woman island", concrete castles, Ballermann: Mallorca's image is negatively affected in some respects. The documentary explores the charm of the largest Balearic island beyond the hustle and bustle of tourism and Rambazamba. The "real" Mallorca is best explored through real Majorcans: Manolo Barahona, TV fishing expert from the local island broadcaster IB3, faces the most difficult task of the year. The Raor is in season, the most expensive fish on the island. Manolo is supposed to get him first in front of the camera and then in the pan. There's only one catch, the little fish with the piranha teeth just doesn't want to be on TV. In the first months of the year Mallorca turns into a sea of almond blossoms. There are around seven million almond trees on the island, once planted to replace dead vines. But now also the almond trees are threatened. The fire bacterium continues to spread, especially on the large plantations. The farmer Biel Torrens wants to save Mallorca's almond trees and fruit with a small organic plantation and gentle harvesting methods. He shakes the almonds from the tree by hand instead of using a mechanical vibrator.

programme.title: Mysterious Oceanic Oases - Hotspots of Life
programme.desc: Countless marine animals frolic on the steep slopes of underwater volcanoes. In many cases, several are rare species not found elsewhere. This is in part due to the fact that plankton clings to the wall and provides the fish with food in abundance. This documentary shows several of these oases and also examines the impact dive tourism has and whether preventive measures can help to maintain them. Nature and underwater filmmaker Rolf Möltgen undertakes dives into the mysterious underwater mountain landscapes with marine scientists from all corners of the globe. This journey takes us to Mexico, to snappers, white-tip reef sharks, Galapagos sharks and giant mantas. We visit the Maldives, Colombia and Costa Rica, where the team documents rare species such as deep sea burbots, small tooth sand tiger and dogfish sharks, in depths of more than 3 metres. The eerie underwater mountain world proves: everyone plays a part in the network of life. Thanks to consistent protective regulations, it has been possible to retain the underwater diversity - especially in the unique oases of the high seas

programme.title: New Life
programme.desc: Baby animals beguile with their innocent charm. But while some remain harmless, others have a deep-rooted instinct. It may take weeks or months of training to hone their skills. Their landscapes and lifestyles maybe very different, but these babies are born to hunt.

programme.title: New Life
programme.desc: It's a water world and life couldn't survive without it. And thanks to it, a mind blowing diversity of creatures thrive beneath the surface. Born to enjoy the riches underwater they must master their body's adaptations, learn to find food, to escape danger and above all become expert swimmers! Whether it's in rivers, on beaches or in the deep ocean, all must overcome the obstacles and fulfil their destiny, all are born to swim! Of all the habitats on earth, the ocean is perhaps the most challenging. Here salt, temperatures, currents and predators can make life difficult; it's not an obvious place to want to bring up your babies… But even in these waters generation after generation beats the odds. They have overcome the challenges and become some of the most beautiful and graceful of creatures. But any baby born to swim has a lot to learn… All over the world there are creatures born to swim, and though humans are not, we seem determined to join them. Perhaps we are envious of their grace. Maybe we are all water babies at heart

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: The Seychelles - Africa with South Seas ambience
programme.desc: The 115 islands and islets that make up the Seychelles present a breath-taking variety of plants, rare animals and beaches laced with palms. This is where the leg-endary Coco de Mer palm nuts grow with fruits weigh-ing up to 20 kilos and giant wild land turtles nibble away at mangrove fruits to their hearts content. The archipelago was first settled at the end of the 18th cen-tury. Today, a very colourful potpourri of peoples in this dwarf state proves just how peacefully different cultures can live side by side. Three times a week, the steamer "MV Espoir" completes the trip from the main island of Mahé to Praslin and back. A ship for every-one and practically everything: Used cars, toilet paper, horses, bicycles, furniture - you name it, the Espoir transports goods of all kinds. Coconuts sometimes pose a problem as there are far too many of them. What to do with them? The best place to send them is undoubt-edly Hubert Roumien's Virgin Coconut Oil Laboratory, hidden away in the Mahé jungle. Straw turns into gold at Seaweed Seychelles! There, Benjamin Port Louis collects seaweed and extracts liquid fertiliser from it.

programme.title: Vicious Beauties - The secret World of the Jelly Fish
programme.desc: Watching the graceful movement of these gelatinous animals is almost hypnotic. Although their bodies are 98% water, jellyfish are deceptively clever and dangerous. But where do these primordial creatures come from? How do they reproduce and how long do they live?

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: mareTV: Estonia's Enchanted Islands - Kihnu, Hiiumaa, Saaremaa & Co
programme.desc: Kihnu is one of 19 inhabited Estonian islands. When the women there ride motorcycles in colourful skirts, it is summer. Thanks to its remoteness, charming traditions have been preserved here. More than 2,000 islands belong to Estonia, none is like the other, each with its own character. Most of them were military restricted areas during the Soviet Union. Of all things, the strict shielding had its good points: beach, forest, juniper groves, they still characterise the landscape of Estonia's enchanted islands. Elly Karjam is a "multi-jobber": lighthouse keeper, ice-cream producer and contract knitter for the famous Kihnu sweaters. Summer is high season for her: She is expecting guests from the USA, who had their ancestors on Kihnu. Birches have to be cut for the so-called viht. This bunch of birch branches is an important accessory for the traditional sauna at midsummer. And the motorcycles in the shed are to be refloated.

programme.title: Loch Ness - Il risveglio del mostro
programme.desc: James Murphy è un criptozoologo alla ricerca del famigerato mostro di Loch Ness, dopo che, alla fine degli anni '70, l'essere gli aveva distrutto la famiglia. Alcuni decenni dopo, l'uomo, si ritroverà fianco fianco del terribile mostro che, nel frattempo, ha anche messo su famiglia.

programme.title: Megashark vs Crocosaurus
programme.desc: Dei minatori in Congo liberano un coccodrillo gigantesco, che inizierà ben presto a seminare il panico. Dall'altra parte del mondo, alcuni marinai s'imbattono in uno squalo gigante. Il coccodrillo riesce ad arrivare in città dopo essere stato inutilmente bombardato da aerei militari. Le due mostruose creature finiranno per trovarsi e si scontreranno per il predominio sul pianeta.

programme.title: Super Shark
programme.desc: Un villaggio turistico sulla spiaggia viene assalito da un mostruoso squalo gigante. I turisti non hanno scampo. Il feroce predatore acquatico dà loro la caccia ovunque, dimostrandosi capace persino di muoversi sulla terraferma.

programme.title: Fauci Crudeli - Cruel Jaws
programme.desc: Tre corpi orribilmente mutilati vengono trovati sulla spiaggia. Si sospetta che il killer sia uno squalo tigre. Prima che altre persone vengano trovate morte, Dag Soerensen, direttore di un piccolo acquario in città, organizza una folle ricerca per uccidere lo squalo. Ma nel frattempo, le persone continuano a morire.

programme.title: Shark week
programme.desc: Divorato dalla sete di vendetta contro chi, a suo vedere, è responsabile della morte del suo unico erede, il milionario Tiburon decide di dare fondo alle sue casse per realizzare un piano folle e intricato. Segrega su un'isola le sette persone coinvolte nella morte del figlio, costringendoli a un gioco al massacro cinico e spietato: difendersi dagli attacchi di sette grandi squali bianchi.

programme.title: Ice Sharks
programme.desc: Una nuova razza di squali famelici e aggressivi emerge dai ghiacci di una stazione di ricerca in Antartide, divorando tutti coloro che incontrano sul loro percorso. Mentre la stazione sprofonda nelle acque gelide, coloro che sono ancora in vita dovranno difendersi con armi di fortuna per evitare di rimetterci la vita.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: Durante un viaggio in Colombia, un gruppo di studenti universitari si addentra nella foresta pluviale alla ricerca di pitture rupestri. Ma tra i cespugli si nasconde un boa constrictor lungo sessanta piedi, che si credeva ormai estinto, assetato di sangue.

programme.title: Mega Piranha
programme.desc: Sul fiume Orinoco, in Venezuela, un gruppo di piranha geneticamente modificati riesce a fuggire durante un esperimento, seminando morte lungo il loro cammino nel mar dei Caraibi, dirigendosi velocemente verso le coste della Florida. L'agente speciale Fitch, insieme alla professoressa Sarah, studiano una strategia per sconfiggerli. Sei pronto a vivere questa battaglia?

programme.title: Tormenta nuclear

programme.title: County Line

programme.title: Los Supervivientes
programme.desc: Samuel, un hombre que vive en los Alpes italianos, decide ayudar a Chehreh, una mujer afgana, a llegar a Francia. Tendrán que enfrentarse a una naturaleza hostil y a la crueldad de los hombres que habitan este territorio.

programme.title: 6 Horas: El final
programme.desc: Un joven tiene sólo seis horas para escapar con su mejor amigo de su ciudad natal antes de que explote un reactor nuclear.

programme.title: Julio César IL CONQUISTATORE DELLE GALLIE
programme.desc: Julio César conduce al ejército romano a la batalla contra los rebeldes de la Galia.

programme.title: Far away: les soldats de l'espoir
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Jun Shik travaille à la ferme du grand-père de Tatsuo alors que la Corée est colonisée par le Japon, mais il rêve de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Tokyo en tant que coureur de marathon. Tatsuo vise également à devenir marathonien, ce qui crée une rivalité entre eux. Mais la guerre éclate et ils sont tous deux forcés de s'enrôler dans l'armée. Tatsuo devient chef de la défense dans l'unité de Jun Shik et élabore un plan qui échoue. Jun Shik et Tatsuo sont capturés par les Soviétiques. Ils s'échappent mais sont rapidement capturés par les Allemands et forcés de se séparer. En 1944, ils se retrouvent sur les plages de Normandie.

programme.title: Poursuite Mortelle
programme.desc: Un groupe de cinq alpinistes fait de la randonnée et de l'escalade dans les Highlands écossais lorsqu'il découvre une jeune fille serbe enterrée dans une petite chambre en pleine nature. Ils se retrouvent alors pris dans un terrifiant jeu du chat et de la souris avec les ravisseurs, alors qu'ils tentent de mettre la jeune fille à l'abri.

programme.title: American Ninja 5
programme.desc: Lorsque la fille d'un scientifique est kidnappée, American Ninja (David Bradley) tente de la retrouver, mais cette fois-ci, il fait équipe avec un jeune qu'il a formé aux techniques du ninja.

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l’établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l’aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l’alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l’empire criminel d’Ik-ho.

programme.title: T-34 Machine de Guerre
programme.desc: À l’époque des plus grandes épreuves de l’histoire de l’humanité, lorsque la vie des êtres chers dépend de chaque action, deux ennemis jurés vont s’effondrer. Retenu captif, le jeune lieutenant Ivushkin prépare une évasion audacieuse. Il rassemble un équipage et défie les as des chars allemands menés par Jager. Pour ses proches et son pays, Ivushkin est prêt à aller jusqu’au bout.

programme.title: Dystopia
programme.desc: Nous sommes en 2037. Notre monde se meurt lentement d'un virus qui a rendu l'humanité stérile. Aucun enfant n'est né depuis 25 ans. Les gouvernements sont devenus les marionnettes impuissantes des plus grandes entreprises et Biocorp, la plus grande du monde, ne cesse de promettre un remède qui ne viendra jamais

programme.title: Funeral Killers
programme.desc: Un jeu du chat et de la souris se déroule au cours d'une seule nuit, lorsque trois criminels armés font irruption dans une morgue et exigent que le médecin légiste et son assistant leur remettent une balle logée dans un cadavre. Alors que les criminels tentent désespérément de cacher leur véritable identité, le médecin se retrouve de plus en plus enlisé dans un bourbier, son passé le rattrapant malgré lui. Chaque rebondissement explosif pousse bientôt les personnages au-delà de leurs limites.

programme.title: Vampire Killers
programme.desc: Leurs femmes ayant été réduites en esclavage par la meute locale de vampires lesbiennes à cause d'une ancienne malédiction, les hommes restants d'un village rural envoient deux jeunes garçons malheureux dans les landes pour les sacrifier.

programme.title: Le Manteau de Chicago
programme.desc: Le Chicago Outfit fut le syndicat du crime organisé le plus puissant du XXe siècle, et Lou Marazano (Frank Vincent) en était le tueur à gages le plus redouté.Vingt ans après sa vague de meurtres la plus célèbre, Lou est devenu une relique : sa légende s’est effacée, son talent oublié, et ses heures de gloire sont derrière lui.Mais lorsque l’arrestation d’un influent représentant syndical pour fraude fiscale menace de révéler une vaste conspiration impliquant policiers, élus et mafieux, le grand patron du Outfit (Armand Assante) ordonne l’élimination de témoins-clés.Pour Lou, c’est l’occasion rêvée de financer sa retraite et de fuir Chicago avec sa compagne (Kathrine Narducci).Mais deux détectives tenaces (Danny Goldring et Stacy Keach) se lancent à ses trousses, et le parrain par intérim (Mike Starr) décide de l’exclure du Outfit.Lou va devoir prouver qu’il mérite toujours son titre d’homme de main le plus meurtrier du Chicago Outfit — un titre qu’il n’a plus porté depuis plus de vingt ans…

programme.title: Chroniques de mutants
programme.desc: À la fin de l'ère glaciaire, La Machine est venue de l'espace pour transformer les hommes en mutants. Cependant, un héros a vaincu cet engin et un grand sceau a été apposé sur La Machine. En 2707, le monde épuisé est gouverné par quatre corporations : Mishima, Bauhaus, Capitol et Imperial, qui sont en état de guerre permanent

programme.title: Special ID
programme.desc: Chan Chi-Lung est infiltré depuis des années dans le gang triadique hongkongais de Cheung Mo-Hung. Suite à l'échec d'une récente négociation menée par Lung avec les trois autres triades locales pour le compte de Hung, ce dernier commence à douter de son identité. Hung entreprend alors d'éliminer tous les policiers infiltrés de son gang, et nombre d'entre eux sont capturés et tués. Pressentant le danger, Lung demande à son capitaine, Cheung, de mettre fin à sa mission d'infiltration. Cependant, Cheung l'envoie en Chine continentale pour infiltrer un trafic de personnalités protégées . Ce trafic est dirigé par Sunny, le protégé de Hung et ancien camarade de Lung au sein du gang. Cheung promet de rétablir l'identité policière de Lung à la fin de la mission, une fois le trafic de Sunny ruiné. Lung accepte, accompagné de l'inspectrice Fang Jing et de son supérieur, Lei Peng, de la police chinoise. Mais avant qu'ils ne puissent atteindre Sunny, cette dernière disparaît soudainement, laissant Lung sans défense et en grand danger.

programme.title: Alpha Rift
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un casque magique emmène Nolan Parthmore dans un monde de chevaliers modernes combattant le mal surnaturel, il est obligé de devenir le héros qu'il était destiné à être.

programme.title: Le Meurtrier
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller d'action haletant, un chauffeur de taxi de Yanji, dans la préfecture autonome coréenne de Yanbian, au nord-est de la Chine, se rend en Corée du Sud à la demande d'un gangster local qui lui propose d'éliminer un professeur en échange du remboursement de sa dette. Parallèlement, il recherche sa femme, venue le rejoindre mais sans nouvelles depuis six mois. Ses soupçons d'infidélité le rongent, jusqu'à ce qu'un événement inattendu survienne cette nuit-là. Alors qu'il s'apprête à tuer le professeur, il se retrouve bientôt en fuite, traqué par la police et la mafia, donnant lieu à de violents combats et à d'intenses courses-poursuites.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.desc: Únete a los Vaqueros, Indios y Sheriffs en nuestro canal para vivir los mejores éxitos del Spaghetti Western, clásicos estadounidenses e incluso versiones colorizadas. ¡Descubre la épica del viejo oeste con nosotros!

programme.title: Le Vent de la Justice
programme.desc: Dans le Far West anarchique, un jeune homme et son frère sont contraints de partir en voyage pour venger la mort de leur père, protéger la tribu Apache qu'ils ont appris à aimer et récupérer la terre et l'or qui leur appartiennent de droit.

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé
programme.desc: Une célèbre ballerine viennoise fuit l'Europe pendant la guerre austro-prussienne et tombe amoureuse d'un bandit américain qui ressemble à son défunt amant royal.

programme.title: Les Aigles noirs de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Lorsque les Comanches se mettent sur le sentier de la guerre, les colons se réfugient à Fort Eagle Rock, commandé par le capitaine Jackson. L'agent secret Cliff McPherson arrive dans ce fort en sous-effectif pour donner des conseils et apporter son soutien. Il apprend que les Comanches ont été attisés par Morton, un éleveur local qui veut prendre le contrôle du pétrole situé sous la réserve des Indiens.

programme.title: La Charge des Cosaques
programme.desc: L'histoire de Hadji Murad, un chef tchétchène du XIXe siècle qui a mené ses guerriers dans une lutte contre les forces d'invasion du tsar russe.

programme.title: Django Kill... Tire encore si tu peux
programme.desc: Diverses factions, dont un bandit métis, une bande de cow-boys homosexuels et un prêtre, se disputent l'or volé dans une ville surréaliste.

programme.title: Winnetou I : LA REVOLTE DES INDIENS APACHES
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un conflit violent éclate entre des cheminots avides et une tribu d'Apaches Mescalero, seuls deux hommes, destinés à devenir des frères de sang, peuvent empêcher une guerre totale : Winnetou, le fils du chef, et Old Shatterhand, un ingénieur allemand.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben et Adam sont enfermés en prison, sur le point d'être pendus pour un crime qu'ils n'ont pas commis. Joe et Hoss doivent découvrir pourquoi les témoins du crime présumé se sont parjurés avant que l'exécution n'ait lieu.

programme.title: Vengeance aux deux visages
programme.desc: Après avoir braqué une banque mexicaine, Dad Longworth s'empare du butin et laisse son complice Rio se faire capturer, mais Rio s'échappe et part à la recherche de Dad en Californie.

programme.title: Django defie Sartana
programme.desc: Le frère du tueur de primes Django, Steve, est lynché après avoir été accusé d'un vol de banque. Django traque Sartana, le supposé complice de Steve, mais le trouve lui aussi innocent. Les deux hommes partent à la recherche des vrais voleurs.

programme.title: Winnetou II : LE TRESOR DES MONTAGNES BLEUES
programme.desc: Forester, un impitoyable baron du pétrole, veut déclencher une guerre entre les tribus amérindiennes et les hommes blancs. Old Shatterhand, Winnetou et leur acolyte Castlepool tentent de l'empêcher.

programme.title: Pour Django les salauds ont un prix
programme.desc: La fiancée de Django a été enlevée. Il doit donc la sauver, mais ce n'est pas une mince affaire. Le problème, c'est que les ravisseurs sont les frères Cortez et leur bande. Ils ont braqué une banque et se sont réfugiés dans une grotte. Django se lance à leur poursuite avec l'aide d'un Américain et de Fulton. Fulton est un agent chargé de ramener l'or à la banque.

programme.title: Clayton L'implacable
programme.desc: La sœur de Clayton est violée et assassinée. L'heure de la vengeance mortelle a sonné !

programme.title: Professionel pour un Massacre
programme.desc: Pris en flagrant délit de vente d'armes volées, trois soldats confédérés obtiennent un sursis du peloton d'exécution, à condition qu'ils se rendent au Mexique pour y récupérer de l'or volé appartenant à la Confédération.

programme.title: Au-delà de la haine
programme.desc: Une famille de pionniers est presque entièrement détruite par des Indiens en quête de vengeance : Le petit George est laissé évanoui sur le sol, et sa petite sœur adoptée par le chef indien. Le destin les réunira à nouveau.

programme.title: On m'appelle King
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes traque une bande de trafiquants d'armes à travers la frontière mexicaine.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Im Erzgebirge haben sich der Mountainbiker Christian und sein bester Freund Til vorgenommen, an zwei Tagen den Bikeman Trail zu bezwingen. Im Allgäu steht John am Abgrund - er testet beim Klippenspringen seinen Mut. Und beim Apnoetauchen im Blindsee erleben Felix und Max einen Tiefenrausch. 15 Meter wollen sie mit nur einem Atemzug bezwingen.

programme.title: Deutschlands Mega-Fabriken
programme.desc: Den Kirschkern im Bodensee sucht man im Halbleiterwerk von Bosch in Reutlingen. Dieser Vergleich gibt das Verhältnis von Festpartikeln zu Kubikmeter Luft wieder, das im Reinraum der Hightech-Fabrik noch geduldet wird. Die hochempfindlichen Sensoren und Mikrochips aus dem Werk werden in Automobilen und Consumer-Elektronik auf der ganzen Welt verbaut.

programme.title: Deutschlands Mega-Fabriken
programme.desc: Henry Ford persönlich soll sich für den Standort der Ford-Werke in Köln Niehl entschieden haben. Heute entstehen hier Tag für Tag über 1.000 neue PKWs. Doch anders als damals, sind hier heute über 1.200 Industrieroboter im Einsatz, 18.000 Mitarbeiter halten das riesige Areal, das wie eine eigene Stadt für sich am Rande Kölns liegt, am Laufen. Die Neuwagen werden in über 60 Nationen exportiert.

programme.title: Deutschlands Mega-Fabriken
programme.desc: Das modernste Traktorenwerk Europas steht in Lauingen und wurde in Rekordzeit erbaut. Von der Grundsteinlegung bis zum Produktionsstart vergingen gerade mal drei Jahre, heute baut der Hersteller Deutz-Fahr in seinem 90 Millionen Euro teuren Werk bis zu 40 Landmaschinen am Tag. programme.title: Deutschlands Mega-Fabriken

programme.title: Stephen Hawking: Reise durchs All
programme.desc: Als Physiker und Raumschiff-Kommandant unternimmt Stephen Hawking eine weitere Reise durch unser Universum. Diesmal verschlägt es ihn zur Venus, zur Sonne und bis hin zum mysteriösen Adlernebel - doch nicht immer verläuft dabei alles nach Flugplan. Die Suche nach der Weltformel und die Lösung des Fermi-Paradoxons stellen selbst für Hawking große Herausforderungen dar.

programme.title: Stephen Hawking: Reise durchs All
programme.desc: Stephen Hawking setzt seine Mission als Raumschiff-Kommandant fort. Er trifft dabei auf eine außerirdische KI und landet auf einer alternativen Erde. Die Suche nach der Weltformel bringt ihn sogar bis an den Rand des Universums. Dabei stellt Hawking auch die Frage, was darüber hinaus existiert und ob wir es nicht vielmehr mit einem "Multiversum" zu tun haben.

programme.title: Mysteriöses Signal aus dem All
programme.desc: Im Green-Bank-Observatorium tief in den Bergen des US-Bundesstaates West Virginia werden rätselhafte Signale empfangen. Könnte dies ein Hinweis auf die Existenz von Leben und sogar anderen Zivilisationen im All sein? Das größte voll bewegliche Radioteleskop der Welt, mit dem Pulsare, Schwarze Löcher und andere interstellare Phänomene beobachtet werden, soll eine Antwort auf diese Frage geben.

programme.title: Le Quatrième Pouvoir
programme.desc: Un journaliste se retrouve impliqué dans un complot terroriste à Moscou alors qu'il enquête sur les services secrets russes.

programme.title: L'homme de ma vie et moi
programme.desc: Niki anime un podcast bien connu sur les relations amoureuses. Lorsqu'un grand éditeur la contacte pour un éventuel contrat de livre, elle se retrouve en difficulté car le podcast est basé sur sa relation avec un petit ami imaginaire, Monsieur Parfait. Elle a besoin d'un remplaçant...

programme.title: La Disparue
programme.desc: Le corps de Yoon Seol Hee disparaît à l'Institut National d'Investigation Scientifique. Le détective Woo Joong Shik cherche des indices sur sa disparition, tandis que son mari Park Jin Han affirme qu'elle est en vie.

programme.title: Dans Les Griffes De La Mode
programme.desc: Une jeune femme travaillant depuis peu pour un magasine très à la mode doit apprendre les rudiments de ce rude métier...

programme.title: Un Endroit Sombre
programme.desc: Lorsqu’un jeune garçon disparaît dans une petite ville tranquille, Donald, un chauffeur de camion de voirie local, se lance dans une enquête précaire et obsessionnelle, jouant les détectives.

programme.title: La retraite de l'amour
programme.desc: Lorsque la marque de beauté Bloom décide de se concentrer sur les ventes en ligne, Jenny doit trouver comment vivre dans l’équilibre travail-vie personnelle , tandis que Nate a déjà trouvé la solution. Lorsque des étincelles jaillissent entre eux, un seul problème se pose : c’est le frère de son patron...

programme.title: Amoureux pour le Show
programme.desc: Suit l’histoire de Tara Thompson, dont la carrière de présentatrice commence à stagner. Elle accepte de participer à une émission télévisée pour épouser son partenaire idéal , Joe, un homme qu’elle n’a jamais rencontré. Mais en secret, elle tente de le retrouver pour clarifier que le mariage n’est que pour...

programme.title: La Nouvelle Locataire
programme.desc: Lorsque son mari est hospitalisé à la suite d'un accident de voiture, Karen, ambulancière, décide de louer leur chambre d'amis en ligne. Tout se passe bien jusqu'à ce que Miranda emménage. Miranda s'infiltre rapidement dans tous les domaines de la vie de Karen. Lorsqu'un des locataires de Karen est retrouvé assassiné, Karen est convaincue que Miranda est impliquée, mais ne se doute pas qu'en mettant son invité psychotique à la porte, Miranda va entrer dans une rage meurtrière.

programme.title: Présomption d'innocence
programme.desc: Une femme est reconnue coupable d'avoir tué son petit ami et sa meilleure amie dans le feu de la passion bien qu'elle ait été défendue par un avocat de renom. Elle s'enfuit après le procès afin de découvrir qui l'a piégée.

programme.title: Les Babysitters
programme.desc: À 17 ans, Shirley Lyner, lycéenne, pense à l'université et gère un service de baby-sitting qui fournit des call-girls adolescentes aux pères de jeunes enfants. Dans un long flashback, nous voyons ce qui l'a amenée à passer du statut de baby-sitter à celui d'organisatrice et de gérante du service. Tout commence avec Michael, le père des enfants dont elle s'occupe. Une tasse de café sur le chemin du retour, une visite nocturne dans une gare de triage, et les choses s'enchaînent. Shirley peut se montrer impitoyable, et la tension monte lorsque certains clients emmènent les filles dans un chalet à la montagne et apportent de la drogue. Puis, l'une des filles tente de se mettre à son compte. Cela peut-il bien se terminer : est-ce une tragédie en devenir ? Avons-nous tous des secrets ?

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam et Tusker voyagent à travers l'Angleterre dans leur vieux camping-car pour voir leurs amis, leur famille et des lieux du passé. Depuis le diagnostic de démence de Tusker, leur temps ensemble le plus précieux de tous.

programme.title: I love my mum
programme.desc: Un duo mère-fils est expédié par inadvertance dans un conteneur de Londres au Maroc avec rien d'autre que leur pyjama. L'aventure les emmène à travers l'Espagne et la France pour rentrer chez eux et reconstruire leur relation rocailleuse.

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Une femme belle, dérangée et dangereuse devient obsédée par un homme marié récemment installé dans le quartier et sème le chaos dans tous les aspects de la vie du couple.

programme.title: Pour de mauvaises raisons
programme.desc: An ensemble film about four everyday people: a store manager, a security guard, a fire fighter and a clerk who struggle in the aftermath of trauma.

programme.title: La Vengeance de Veronica
programme.desc: Un avion disparaît mystérieusement, emportant à son bord la sœur jumelle de Verónica, victime de l'escroquerie d'un millionnaire, Frederico. Donnée pour morte, Veronica prend l'identité de sa sœur Vitória et souhaite se venger de la famille de l'entrepreneur, trouvant en Diana, son épouse, une adversaire de taille. Au milieu de cette guerre, Jaime, le neveu de Veronica, qui souffre d'un cancer et doit être sauvé, comme Rodrigo, le grand amour de Diana dans le passé, mais disputé par les deux rivaux dans le présent.

programme.title: Sortilège
programme.desc: Alejandro rentre chez lui après un terrible accident et découvre qu'il est marié à Maria Jose, une pauvre fille innocente qui a été trompée par Bruno, le frère d'Alejandro. Bruno a utilisé le nom d'Alejandro pour épouser Maria Jose, peu après avoir envoyé tuer son frère dans l'espoir que Maria Jose hérite de la fortune d'Alejandro. Mais lorsque Maria Jose arrive au manoir, elle se rend compte que Bruno lui a menti et s'est servi d'elle.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S01 E01 - Canada - Ocean To Ocean
programme.desc: Friends Scott Wilson and Justin Lukach leave the 9-to-5 to travel the world for a year. But before they depart, they decide to explore their own country first. They rent an RV in Halifax and hit the road, camping all the way from the Atlantic to the Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: After landing in Jordan, Scott and Justin are greeted by their friend Ibrahim who is getting married in a few weeks. They spend a night in the desert with the Bedouins, travel to Petra and the gulf of Aqaba, all just in time for the big day.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E09 - Ethiopia - Dances With Bulls
programme.desc: Scott and Justin meet up with Robel, who takes the guys to visit his sisters in his village of Harar. They visit the bustling chat market, and learn how to prepare the traditional stimulant. That night, Robel takes them to feed some wild hyenas by hand. Leaving Harar, they take a long drive to visit the Hammer Tribe. Here they witness a rare ceremony in which the women of the village offer themselves to be whipped, and one soon-to-be married man has to run, stark naked over a dozen bulls, to prove his worth as a husband.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Rwanda is a country emerging from its darkest years of poaching and the 1994 genocide. Scott and Justin travel with locals to learn more about how Rwanda is managing today. They explore the recovery of the animal population – from swimming cows on Napoleon Island to trekking into the wild to visit isolated groups of mountain gorillas. This experience is contrasted with a visit to the church of Ntarama to talk to a genocide survivor, and a court tribunal of several accused men. The guys hear stories of forgiveness from the people, and learn of their hope for their country.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: The guys arrive in the arctic destination at the beginning of winter. With only six hours of sunlight a day, they experience an entirely different type of adventure. Arriving by helicopter into the town of Ittoqqortoormiit, they take part in a seat hunt, and learn of the many ways people survive in this harsh arctic climate. With some basic training under their belt, the team heads off on a three-day trek to the abandoned ghost town of Cape Hope, where weather and extreme conditions pushes everyone’s utmost limits.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E12 - North Korea - The Other Side
programme.desc: Scott and Justin are prepared for perhaps their greatest adventure to date, providing them with a rare glimpse inside the borders of this isolated country. From Beijing, they depart to Pyongyang with an Englishman named Nick – an outsider with unprecedented access to the country. Meeting up with their local guides, Chae and Kim, the team visits many historical and political sights, learning the local perspective on world events, and gaining a much greater understanding of the country. An evening cruise down the Taedong River begins to cement a solid friendship between the guys and their guides.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E13 - North Korea - The Musical
programme.desc: North Koreans are a fiercely proud and creative people. North Korea continues to completely defy all expectations, as Scott and Justin take part in a high school English class, are pulled into numerous musical performances, visit a water bottling factory, a farm and an old funfair. Their experiences are capped off by the largest and most impressive choreographed spectacle on earth – the Arirang Mass Games – where 100,000 people perform the ultimate homage to their country and ideologies. The guys are sad to leave their trusted guides and friends behind when they depart by train back to Beijing.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E14 - Indonesia - Ring Of Fire
programme.desc: The trip begins on the caldera of Mount Bromo - an active, yet serene volcano in the middle of the island of Java. With their local friend Oka, they continue to the slums of Jakarta, meeting with a young boy and his family, and participating in daily activities to learn of the many hardships facing the locals. Heading to the island paradise of Bali, they take part in an explosive, traditional bull race. Scott gets “dirty” while Oka loses his chariot altogether. The trip winds down when they meet a Balinesian Prince, and join his party as guests of honour.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E15 - Indonesia - A Home Away
programme.desc: For three years, Scott and Justin have travelled the globe, experiencing so many people’s homes, while getting further away from their own. In their friend Oka’s home island of Bali, the guys witness both spiritual and illegal aspects of Balinesian life - grand temples, noisy bird markets and betting on underground cricket fights. They then travel back in time to the island of Sumba, staying overnight with a tribe who live in close harmony with nature and their ancestors. While Justin ponders returning home, Scott realizes that after three years on the road, there are more similarities between people and cultures than differences.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: From the southern coast of Adelaide, all the way to Darwin, the guys take on another road trip - this time with their own purchased 4x4 to get them through the perilous, dusty outback. Fighting constant breakdowns, they reach the underground town of Coober Pedy, where they search for opal with the help of an explosives “expert”. The crew travel from Uluru, staying on a working ranch, before tackling the ultimate off-road adventure through searing sand to remote Boggy Hole. Pushing on through a sudden rainstorm in the north, to the last miles to Darwin, Scott, Justin, and Andre have now travelled to all seven continents. What’s next?

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E01 - Russia - Comrades And Capitals
programme.desc: Anything is possible in Russia. Scott and Justin meet up with their friend Bogdan and visit the last man living in the radioactive zone in Chernobyl. They visit St. Petersburg for some homemade vodka and to celebrate Bogdan’s birthday, before hopping on an overnight train to Moscow. The adventures in Moscow are diverse: An awkward visit to a Russian bath, a wild night out in an exhilarating dance club and a chance to drive a cold-war military tank. Next, they fly to Siberia and meet a vodka-slamming shaman, who puts them all to shame on the dance floor.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E02 - Russia - The Bull Of Winter
programme.desc: The guys head northeast into Siberia to reach the coldest inhabited place on earth: the Pole of Cold. Along the way, the word of Scott and Justin’s journey travels and they become local news celebrities. They visit a permanent circus, take part in the Festival of Cold, answer questions at local press conferences and end up judging a quirky beauty contest in Yakutsk. Riding reindeer for the rest of the trek, they camp in the snow before hitting the Pole of Cold.

programme.title: Bruised 2
programme.desc: Two years after the death of her husband, Kayla Brown has rebuilt her life following the launch of her successful memoir. she is then visited by a stalker, who is hell-bent on making her pay for what she has done in order to escape her husband.

programme.title: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Jessica is the smartest girl on campus tutoring the most popular football player, Ryan. He is loved by many but he also has a few enemies. After the football team wins the championship game, Ryan decides to throw an after party at his house. When campus police find Ryan’s dead body, multiple people have a motive to want him dead. Will Jessica and her friend uncover the truth before it’s too late?

programme.title: Intrigue
programme.desc: Jessica and Darren's marriage has hit a rocky stage in their lives. When a mysterious man named Michael enters her life, Jessica is intrigued explores options that could have deadly consequences.

programme.title: Predatory Behavior
programme.desc: When women start disappearing all over the city, Detective Powell and Scott take on the case hoping to bring the culprit to justice. Can they find the elusive killer or will it be to late for the next victim.

programme.title: Queen of the Trap House
programme.desc: When Kionna is asked to step in and take control of her jailed boyfriend, Tyreek's, drug empire, she reluctantly agrees, but her new position as Queen of the Trap House suits her more than expected.

programme.title: Born Again Baddie
programme.desc: Following a tragic car accident that claimed her mother’s life and left her father paralyzed, Nia is desperate and forced into a life of crime. After expanding her business and becoming the queen pin of the city, tragedy strikes and it forces her to find solace and reflection on her past life choices.

programme.title: Legends of the Highway
programme.desc: Follow the true story of the Florida Highwaymen, 26 self-taught African American artists who forged their own path to success in the segregated 1950’s and 60’s. Their stories are guided by the mentorship of renowned landscape painters A.E. Backus, Alfred Hair, and Harold Newton. Their troupe captured Florida’s breathtaking landscapes and sold their paintings along state highways, circumventing the traditional art world that excluded them.

programme.title: Runway of Shadows
programme.desc: Sisters Ivy and Zara are separated at a very young age due to their father’s deceit. When Ivy and Zara unexpectedly cross paths at a prestigious runway show, the stage it set for a series of mysterious and unsettling events.

programme.title: Commandments of a Female Hustler
programme.desc: Three childhood friends, Lala, Binky, and Jay grew up together on the streets of East Baltimore. Wanting a better life for themselves, they learn the ways of hustling. When they align themselves with one of the most powerful drug dealers in the game, their loyalties are tested, and the very commandments that once bound them start to break.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Broken Harmony
programme.desc: Recording artist Harmony Brown, listens to every suggestion from her record label including changing her sound, changing her look, and even changing the type of music she sang. Yet, her numbers aren’t improving, and she’s on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she’s forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

programme.title: Love Kills
programme.desc: In the heart of Atlanta's unpredictable dating scene, Darron is a hopeless romantic with the worst luck imaginable. Every time he believes he's found "the one," he ends up caught in another tangled web of passion, betrayal, and danger. When Darron finally meets someone who seems genuine, his past mistakes come back with a vengeance. One of his exes' jealous boyfriends discovers their hidden affair, setting off a chain of events that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Single Forever
programme.desc: The Dawkins Brothers are back with another wild adventure! When Herc decides to retire from the porn industry, he looks to make a career change into stand-up comedy. His dreams are threatened whenever his ex-girlfriend is released from prison, and looks to take her revenge on how he did her wrong.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a local DJ is crushed to death at a traditional girls boarding school, new DCI John Barnaby soon discovers that murder and deception are never far away.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The reclusive life of elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham comes under police scrutiny when a social services investigator is killed. Barnaby and Jones must unearth generations of secrets

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a young woman is dressed like a bride and drowned in a bath, it triggers a spate of ghoulish wedding-themed murders in Great Worthy. The case takes Barnaby and Jones to a donkey sanctuary.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Jones goes undercover at the Oblong Foundation after one of the cults young female members disappears suddenly. But he and Barnaby soon start digging into an old case.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Fingers point at local druids when a farmer is found horribly murdered at a sacred stone circle in Midsomer Mow. But Barnaby is convinced that basic human greed is the real motive for murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a missing tax inspector turns up dead in a vat of cider, Barnaby and Jones must hunt for a giant killer within a Midsomer village steeped in bizarre local traditions.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The cloistered world of Midsomer Priory is forced to open its doors to 21st century policing when a nun is strangled to death.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A row between keen birdwatchers in Midsomer-in-the-Marsh turns nasty when their president is killed.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Emily Simpson is found dead in her house, DCI Barnaby's instincts all lead him to suspect murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A writers' circle are about to witness a sequence of gruesome events far stranger than any fiction.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The peace of Ferne Basset is shattered when the body of quiet animal lover Agnes Gray is bludgeoned to death and found floating in the nearby river. The case is far from easy, when her cousin, Esslyn Carmichael, inadvertently cuts his own throat on stage during the final act of a production of Amadeus. Many of the village and of the Causton Amateur Dramatics' Society loathed him.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Morton Fendle are up in arms when they discover the local craft centre, which they had invested in, is in financial uncertainty. As Barnaby tries to stop matters from escalating, he soon learns that its owner Alan Hollingsworth's wife Simone has been kidnapped. Shortly after following Alan to the nearby market town, and witnessing him dropping off a valise, a neighbor of his is murdered when her car is forced off the road and collides with a stationary log lorry.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Bill Carter, one of the founders of a New Age commune called the 'Lodge of the Golden Windhorse', dies after falling down the stairs and breaking his neck. Barnaby and Troy arrive to investigate and meet many of the commune's quirky residents. They need to work out whether it was just an unfortunate accident or murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Midsomer Deverell are angered over plans by the Inkpen family to convert the public memorial garden into a tea shop. When Elspeth Inkpen's daughter 'Fliss' is found murdered in the garden, shortly after a village meeting, Barnaby and Troy suspect that someone may be determined to stop the destruction. As their investigations continue, they discover a web of snobbery, greed, illegitimacy and mourning.
